ModMetaData.name: Call of Cthulhu - Cosmic Horrors Reforjed
ModMetaData.author: Jecrell
ModMetaData.description:
Lovecraftian monsters for RimWorld 1.6: Star-Spawn, Shoggoths, Mi-Go, Deep Ones, Star Vampires, Dark Young and Chthonians, with sanity effects, sounds and incidents. Port running on Rework Reforjed (required, load it first). Adds optional taming, an Anomaly entity codex, corpse analysis and dynamic spawns; full manual in README.md.
Monstruos lovecraftianos para RimWorld 1.6 con efectos de cordura, sonidos e incidentes. Port sobre Rework Reforjed (obligatorio, cargalo antes). Tameo opcional, codex de Anomaly, analisis de cadaveres y apariciones dinamicas; manual en README_ES.md.
